text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't... win...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Ugh... damn it... I gave it... everything 
I had...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I thought through everything to win... And 
yet...â

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to race with everyone again...! If 
so—I have to surpass who I am right now!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The path to the summit is still long... 
Let us push forward, far beyond our 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My limit...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Is this the place, my...—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Sky-san. That wasn't a bad run 
at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However! Next will be my stage. Enter the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)—I expect to see you 
there.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Having overcome today to become truly 
top-tier, this King shall be your 
opponent!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, say something.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Why aren't you running your mouth like 
usual, saying, 'Oh, there goes King saying 
silly things again~'?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Boring.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Everything has just... become so boring.

Seiun Sky blurted something out, instantly 
freezing the air in the room.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't mean anything. ...Let's go 
back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hmm, hmm-hmm~.

Seiun Sky acted aloof as usual. However, I 
couldn't simply overlook what she had just 
said.
choice_data_list: What do you mean, it got boring?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Not you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I only muttered a little something under 
my breath, and both of you are taking it 
way too seriously~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Even Sei-chan says pointless things 
sometimes! Don't get so worked up over 
it☆"
choice_data_list:
...Well then, let's move on to the next 
topic.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Next time, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, the race King suggested sounds fine 
to me~.

Having proven herself in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), she'll now want to show off that 
same strength this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, something like that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Running only in major races... Sei-chan 
really is amazing.

Seiun Sky mutters as if it's someone 
else's problem. Her eyes seem to be 
looking off into the distant horizon...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, Sei-chan has a stop to make. Go 
ahead and head back to the academy first.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...The training camp is coming up soon, so 
Trainer, please go ahead with the 
preparations.

"...It seems she won't let me probe any 
further. Though worry lingered, 
remembering the fighting spirit she showed 
at last year's summer camp... I decided to 
trust her."
